messages:
Elaine (Recruiter): @Priya heads-up — new hire Sophia L's EAD renewal is pending. Currently shows expiry 2026-04-10. Offer accepted for 2026-04-01 start. Thoughts on contingency? :wave:
Priya - People Ops: Thanks Elaine. We can't have paid duties before work auth. We can onboard for unpaid admin tasks and orientation but not billable work. We should confirm dates and see if we can delay start or get proof of renewal receipt.
Jordan R (Payroll): Quick FYI — payroll needs a valid work authorization on file to set up pay. If renewal receipt (I-797C) exists, we can set provisional pay hold? Need to confirm with legal. @Priya
Alex P (Hiring Manager): That's not great — team is scheduled for client kickoff week of 4/5. Is there any interim we can do remotely that isn't "work"? We need to keep momentum.
Priya - People Ops: We can allow access to learning modules, team intros, slack, and orientation docs. No PRs or client-facing work. Also request Sophia to upload the USCIS notice or biometric receipt to the portal.
Sophia L (New Hire): Hi all — I filed last month, biometrics done on 3/2. I have the USCIS receipt (I-797C) and the biometrics appointment confirmation. Uploading now.
people-ops-bot: Document uploaded by Sophia L: i797c_receipt.pdf (stored to HR Secure bucket) :white_check_mark:
Priya - People Ops: Good. Please also upload a scan of passport + current EAD front/back for our file. We'll check for premium processing eligibility. @Elaine, can you flag legal on this?
Elaine (Recruiter): Looping legal — cc @Legal (I'll ping them). Sophia, can you confirm travel plans? If you need to depart US before approval we need to discuss consular risk.
Jordan R (Payroll): If we can't verify continuous work auth by payroll cutoff (4/15), we'll need to delay first paycheck to next period. We can set an exception hold and run a manual pay if cleared later — keep receipts handy.
Priya - People Ops: Two practical paths: 1) Push start to 2026-04-12 (safe buffer after expected adjudication), or 2) start 4/1 for orientation-only and convert to paid once EAD is received. Which do you prefer, Alex?
Alex P (Hiring Manager): Option 2 preferred if legal signs off. We can front-load non-billable onboarding week.
Priya - People Ops: OK — I'll draft a contingent start addendum for Sophia: unpaid onboarding from 4/1–4/11, paid employment begins on EAD receipt. Addendum will include list of allowed activities, doc upload steps, and reimbursement policy for premium processing if applicable.
Elaine (Recruiter): Sounds good. Sophia, are you open to the addendum?
Sophia L (New Hire): Yes, I can do that. Appreciate the flexibility. Quick Q: if EAD arrives mid-pay period, how do you handle retro pay?
Jordan R (Payroll): Retro pay is possible but needs final docs before payroll close. If EAD arrives before 4/20 we should be able to retro to 4/1; otherwise pay will start from clearance date. We'll confirm after legal OK.
Priya - People Ops: Action items:
```
- Sophia: upload I-797C and passport + EAD scans to HR portal
- Elaine: ping Legal for sign-off on unpaid orientation clause
- Jordan: note payroll exception and hold manual pay instructions
- Priya: draft contingent addendum and send to candidate
```
Elaine (Recruiter): I'll handle legal ping and candidate messaging today. ETA by EOD.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: "Check EAD status for Sophia L" on 2026-03-30 09:00
Priya - People Ops: Thanks everyone. If premium processing becomes an option and Sophia wants us to reimburse (per policy), send receipts to expenses@redwood.com and tag "visa-expense".
Sophia L (New Hire): Uploaded docs and confirmation. Thanks all :pray:
Alex P (Hiring Manager): Great, keep me posted. If legal gives green light we'll start the orientation plan.
Priya - People Ops: Closing loop — I'll post the signed addendum here once executed. :thumbsup:
